Emergency Implant Care

Knocked Out a Tooth?

Sports injury, accident or fall? We have extensive experience restoring smiles after dental trauma. Get your confidence back fast.

Emergency Consultation1-Hour Consultation — £80Call 020 71833573

✓ Same-Day Emergency Slots · ✓ Natural-Looking Results · ✓ 0% Finance*

Losing a front tooth due to a sports injury, fall, or accident is a traumatic experience, both physically and emotionally. The sudden alteration to your smile can be shocking.

Unlike teeth lost to gum disease, trauma often affects healthy teeth and healthy bone. However, the impact can fracture the root or knock the tooth out completely (avulsion). Speed is critical. If a tooth cannot be replanted, preserving the bone socket is the top priority to support the best possible outcome with an implant.

At Dental Implants London, we offer priority appointments for trauma cases to assess damage and may be able to place a temporary tooth, where clinically appropriate.

Immediate Actions

Act Fast

If the tooth is knocked out whole, try to put it back in the socket or keep it in milk/saliva. See a dentist within 60 minutes.

Assess Fractures

If the tooth is broken at the gum line, do not wiggle it. The root may still be salvageable or useful for immediate implant placement.

The Treatment

Restoring What Was Lost

For trauma cases, achieving a natural-looking result is a key priority. We aim to closely match the replacement tooth to the surrounding teeth.

Immediate Replacement

In many trauma cases, we can extract the broken root and place an implant + temporary crown in one visit.

Bone Preservation

We gently manage the socket to prevent the gum from receding, ensuring the new tooth looks like it grows naturally from the gum.

Color Matching

Our lab technicians custom shade the final Zirconia crown to match the translucency and texture of your other front teeth.

We Are Here to Help

Don't panic. Modern implant dentistry can restore the appearance of your smile, where possible.
